Nadia, Gideon landed on 280 seats for Vantorre Group. I posted this as a reply to your message in #strategic-pod.

His July 1 update first said 300. About five minutes later (09:19) he corrected it to 280 active seats on the production roster. The 300 had included sandbox logins from the May rollout. Ruth acknowledged the 280 in the same thread, so that's the number for your roster sheet.
